# Getting help

KN990x projects are maintained by one person in their spare time. There is no paid
support, but questions and reports are welcome.

- **Read first:** the repository's README covers installation, configuration and the
  common problems. The product sites (easypages.app, pullpilot.app, vuzon.cc) have the full
  documentation.
- **Found a bug?** Open an issue with the bug report template and include the version or
  image tag you run.
- **Have an idea?** Open an issue with the feature request template. Explain the problem
  you want solved before the solution you have in mind.
- **Security problem?** Do not open an issue: follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md).

If a project saves you time and you want to support it, there is a
[Ko-fi page](https://ko-fi.com/kn990x).
